ask: Design the session questions page: what the session publishes, how I answer, and how answers get back.
note: Build the 'Copy answers' path first; it works on Max and Enterprise. Add comments sent to Claude for sessions on your Enterprise account (needs in-organization sharing). A session on the API key cannot publish artifacts. Since Oct 26, c31 (a question waiting on you reaches you) and c28 (a step left to you comes as a one-click command) cover how a question reaches you; this step is the page it lands on. Overlaps o7 and o8; the triage thread holds that overlap. Triage, Oct 26: kept apart from o8. o8 is the lasting repo page; this is the live session page that c31's alert and c28's one-click command point to.
title: A page per session for questions waiting on you
why: Two levels: the repo roadmap is lasting, a session page is live. Each busy session publishes its plan (done, now, next) and its open questions, each with Goal, Problem, and options with gain and loss. You answer on the page instead of in the terminal.
